title: Reopen the two Gson reader changes at a stable JAR path
description: Add an unselected file, then replace only the fixed Gson JAR with verified original parent bytes at the same pathname. Compare independent clean and incremental scopes, caller identities, physical outcomes and witnesses for all four preregistered questions. Require unaffected parent sides to reuse and every replaced side to execute.
